title: Faithful flatness is stable under ring base change
statement: Let R -> S be a faithfully flat map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], and let R -> R' be any ring map. Then the base-changed map R' -> R' tensor_R S, r' |-> r' tensor 1, is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00HI (lemma-flat-base-change, line 8889), Lemma Tag 00FI (lemma-surjective-spec-radical-ideal, line 5822), and Lemma Tag 00HQ (lemma-ff-rings, line 9164)
